2: A maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing forever of Yahweh’s acts of loyal love. ⌞From generation to generation⌟ I will make known your faithfulness with my mouth.
3: For I say, “Forever your loyal love is built up. The heavens you have established with your faithfulness in them.”
4: “I made a covenant with my chosen one; I swore an oath to David my servant:
5: ‘I will establish your descendants forever, and I will build up your throne ⌞from generation to generation⌟.’” Selah
6: And so the heavens will praise your wonderful deed, O Yahweh, even your faithfulness, in the assembly of the holy ones.
7: For who in the sky is equal to Yahweh? Who is like Yahweh among the sons of God,
8: a God feared greatly in the council of the holy ones, and awesome above all surrounding him?
9: O Yahweh God of hosts, who is mighty like you, O Yah, with your faithfulness surrounding you?
10: You are ruling the surging of the sea. When its waves rise, ⌞you yourself still⌟ them.
11: ⌞You yourself crushed⌟ Rahab like one who is slain; you scattered your enemies with your strong arm.
12: The heavens are yours, the earth yours as well, the world with its fullness, because you founded them.
13: North and south, you created them; Tabor and Hermon shout joyfully over your name.
14: You have a mighty arm; Your hand is strong; your right hand reaches high.
15: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loyal love and faithfulness come before your face.
16: Blessed are the people who know the joyful shout; O Yahweh, they walk about in the light of your countenance.
17: In your name they rejoice all the day, and in your righteousness they rise up.
18: For you are the glory of their strength, and by your favor our horn rises up,
19: because our shield belongs to Yahweh, and our king to the Holy One of Israel.
20: Formerly you spoke in a vision to your faithful ones, and said, “I have bestowed help on a mighty man; I have exalted one chosen from the people.
21: I have found David, my servant. With my holy oil I have anointed him,
22: with whom my hand will be steadfast. Surely my arm will strengthen him.
23: The enemy will not deceive him, and no ⌞evil man⌟ will afflict him.
24: But I will crush his adversaries before him, and I will strike those who hate him.
25: And so my faithfulness and my loyal love will be with him, and in my name his horn will rise up.
26: And I will set his hand on the sea and his right hand on the rivers.
27: He will call out to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.’
28: I will also make him the firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
29: Forever I will keep my loyal love for him, and my covenant will be reliable for him.
30: I will also establish his offspring forever, and his throne as the days of the heavens.
31: If his sons forsake my law and do not walk in my judgments,
32: if they defile my statutes and do not keep my commandments,
33: then I will punish their transgression with a rod, and their guilt with wounds.
34: But I will not break off my loyal love from him, and I will not be false against my faithfulness.
35: I will not defile my covenant, or alter what proceeded from my lips.
36: Once I have sworn by my holiness, ‘I will surely not lie to David,
37: His offspring will endure forever, and his throne as the sun before me.
38: Like the moon it will be steadfast forever, and like an enduring witness in the sky.’” Selah
39: But you have spurned and rejected; you are very angry with your anointed one.
40: You have repudiated the covenant with your servant; you have defiled his crown in the dirt.
41: You have broken down all his walls; you have made his fortifications a ruin.
42: All passing along the road plunder him; he has become a taunt to his neighbors.
43: You have raised the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all his enemies rejoice.
44: You have also turned back the edge of his sword and have not helped him stand his ground in the battle.
45: You have made his splendor to cease, and cast his throne to the ground.
46: You have cut short the days of his youth; you have covered him with shame. Selah
47: How long, O Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire forever?
48: Remember what my lifespan is. Remember for what vanity you have created all the children of humankind.
49: What man can live on and not see death? Can he deliver his life from the ⌞power⌟ of Sheol? Selah
50: Where are your former acts of loyal love, O Lord, that you swore to David by your faithfulness?
51: Remember, O Lord the taunting of your servants, how I bear in my bosom the taunts of all the many peoples,
52: by which your enemies taunt, O Yahweh, by which they taunt the steps of your anointed one.
53: Blessed be Yahweh forever. Amen and Amen.
